title: Hudl Technique Score Regression Post-Injury
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hudl:clip
streamstats window=5 avg(technique_score) as baseline
where technique_score<baseline*0.9
description: Detects Hudl technique score drops after returning from injury.
value: Surfacing hudl technique score regression post-injury helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant sports, skills & training telemetry export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It shows when hudl technique score regression post-injury matters for your routine.
